scope: Kaby i5-8250U Qwen3/Qwen2.5 strict CPU warm-session performance lane after SLM-CPU-180
claim_boundary: SLM-CPU-181 records the exact output-storage dependencies that block runtime allocation reuse across dense-linear, residual-add, final-norm, and model.forward boundaries.
This is a dependency register, not an implementation slice.
No runtime behavior changes are made in this slice.
No allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, Q4/Q5, server, GPU/NPU/OpenVINO/UHD 620, Qwen3.5, or BitNet QK256 claim is made.

dependency_register.needed_surface: Tensor::matmul_out or equivalent caller-owned output storage API
dependency_register.why_required: Current Candle matmul and Linear::forward return owned Tensor storage. Reusing caller-owned output storage for dense linear outputs requires an API that writes matmul results into verified storage without changing shape, dtype, device, broadcast, or autograd-free CPU semantics.
dependency_register.repo_owned_alternative: narrow packed-Q8/source-order helper inside an exact tensor evidence boundary
dependency_register.repo_owned_alternative_status: only acceptable for scoped sidecar experiments; not a general model.forward allocation-reuse solution
evidence_required_before_runtime_promoti: API evidence that the output-storage matmul preserves Candle numerical behavior for Qwen3 Q8_0 and Qwen2.5 Q8_0

paired before/after strict warm-session receipts preserving prompt IDs, generated IDs, decoded text, model SHA, tokenizer source, selected CPU backend/kernel, dense path identity, and fallback_used=false
allocation counters isolating the affected dense-linear output boundary
phase timing fields for affected warm-session prompts before any timing claim

dependency_register.current_surface: Tensor add / broadcast_add through Candle Tensor operators
dependency_register.needed_surface: Tensor::broadcast_add_out, Tensor::add_out, or equivalent caller-owned residual-add output API
blocked_boundaries: block output handoff to next layer or final norm
dependency_register.why_required: SLM-CPU-180 shows feed_forward.down_proj.output is immediately consumed by the block residual add. Avoiding a returned dense-linear Tensor is not enough if residual add still materializes a fresh owned Tensor.
dependency_register.repo_owned_alternative: multi-stage typed Tensor view or fused residual-add consumer
dependency_register.repo_owned_alternative_status: future design only; too broad for the current dense-linear caller-output-storage gate
evidence_required_before_runtime_promoti: explicit shape, dtype, device, aliasing, and broadcast semantics for residual add output storage
trace/workspace identity preservation for both down_proj output and block output
paired Qwen3/Qwen2.5 strict generated-ID preservation receipts
allocation counters proving the residual-add allocation boundary is affected

dependency_register.current_surface: LayerNorm/RMSNorm forward paths returning owned Tensor outputs
dependency_register.needed_surface: LayerNorm/RMSNorm output-storage API or a repo-owned strict CPU norm implementation with caller-owned output storage
dependency_register.why_required: The model.forward allocation chain crosses norm boundaries after residual adds and before dense projections. Dense-linear output reuse does not remove allocation churn if the next norm still returns an owned Tensor and becomes the next projection input.
dependency_register.repo_owned_alternative: strict CPU RMSNorm/LayerNorm implementation with explicit output buffer and reference parity receipts
dependency_register.repo_owned_alternative_status: possible future runtime slice, but not implemented or selected here
evidence_required_before_runtime_promoti: per-model norm variant identity for Qwen3 and Qwen2.5
before/after generated-ID preservation receipts
checkpoint or tensor-summary parity against current Candle norm outputs
allocation counters for norm output boundaries

dependency_register.current_surface: owned Candle Tensor handoff between transformer stages
dependency_register.needed_surface: typed Tensor view/handoff design that preserves Candle-compatible shape, dtype, device, aliasing, trace, workspace, and receipt identity
blocked_boundaries: block output to next layer input
final norm output to output-head logits
dependency_register.why_required: A repo-owned fused consumer would need to cross several Tensor identity boundaries. Without a typed handoff design, replacing owned Tensor returns risks changing traces, workspace recording, stop-policy visibility, or receipt/checkpoint comparability.
dependency_register.repo_owned_alternative_status: non-runtime design note until exact API contract and paired strict receipts exist
evidence_required_before_runtime_promoti: documented type contract for shape, dtype, device, aliasing, lifetime, and trace identity
explicit fallback behavior when the typed view cannot be produced
paired Qwen3/Qwen2.5 strict warm-session before/after receipts
no generated-ID, decoded-text, prompt-ID, tokenizer-source, model-SHA, backend/kernel, or fallback-status drift

dependency_register.current_surface: strict receipts record model/tokenizer/backend/fallback and dense hook identity where present
dependency_register.needed_surface: receipt-visible selected output-storage path and allocation-boundary identity for any future output-storage runtime promotion
dependency_register.why_required: Any optimization must prove unchanged generated behavior and expose the selected path. A hidden output-storage fallback would weaken the Kaby appliance proof discipline.
dependency_register.repo_owned_alternative: extend the existing strict receipt shape only when a runtime candidate exists
evidence_required_before_runtime_promoti: requested and selected output-storage path identifiers
fallback_used and fallback_reason for output-storage selection
allocation-boundary counters for before/after comparison
paired Qwen3/Qwen2.5 generated-ID preservation receipts

repo_owned_design_dependencies: typed Tensor view / owned handoff contract
allocation-boundary counters for dense-linear, residual-add, norm, and model.forward boundaries
dependency_summary.recommended_next_action: Do not promote dense-linear caller-output storage from the current gate. Either wait for/adopt exact Candle output-storage APIs with receipts, or open a separate non-runtime design item for typed Tensor handoff semantics. Continue measured Kaby performance work on other frontiers only when paired strict Qwen3/Qwen2.5 receipts preserve behavior.
